integrity: The two critical polynomial coboundaries and canonical equilibria were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. Conditional-expectation arguments were reconstructed directly from the invariant-measure generator identity; literature comparisons are limited to material actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and periodic orbits, not unbounded trajectories.
For a general invariant measure the horizontal defect forces positive mass outside the equilibrium x-slab but does not by itself force positive mass in its interior.
The 1994 foundational source was inspected at publisher-metadata and abstract level rather than line by line.
The 2004 all-Sprott analytical paper was inspected only through indexed metadata and abstract-level material.
Targeted literature searches cannot exclude differently phrased or unindexed older identities.
title: Exact conditional regressions and sharp equilibrium-slab excursions in the generalized Sprott H flow
